scan.title: At the Lagoon

sentences: The class walks to the lagoon on a warm morning.

Leyla: What are those? They have no bones and they move slowly.

Sam: That's interesting! So which animal is the worst swimmer?

Nora: There are a lot of starfish on these rocks! A sea turtle dives under the water, too.

Leyla: Card three is about fishing nets. Dolphins get into them. You mustn't leave a net in the water.
Nora: Card four is pollution. Dirty water is the worst home for marine animals.
Sam: Card five is about hunting. People hunt whales and sharks. You mustn't hunt them!
Leyla: Card six is climate change. The ocean gets warm and the jellyfish move away.
Ms. Reed: Which card goes first, children?
Nora: Plastic. There is a lot of plastic on every beach. That is the worst one.
Leyla: That's a good point. We pin the plastic card at the top!

Nora: Nehirlere ya da göllere atık atmamalıyız. Atık okyanusa çok çabuk ulaşır.
Sam: Deniz kaplumbağalarını avlamamalısın. Avcılık onlar için büyük bir tehlikedir.
